caption: The drawing features a single object, a fringed jacket, centered on a plain, off-white background. The jacket appears to be made of suede or leather and is depicted in muted shades of brown and tan. The collar, front opening, and edges of the jacket are detailed with a darker brown line. A prominent feature of the jacket is the extensive fringe that extends from both shoulders down the sleeves and along the chest. The sleeves are cuffed, and the bottom hem and sleeves have a slightly scalloped or rough edge. The artist's signature, "ELLEN DUNCAN," is located near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Trapper's Jacket
